Applying a roll-on immediately after shaving can also cause stinging or burning sensations, as the skin is more sensitive. To avoid irritation and discomfort, it is recommended to wait at least 10-15 minutes after shaving before applying an underarm roll-on. Face skin is thinner, acne-prone, and spends more time under makeup — it needs a lightweight, non-comedogenic formula. Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About Hair Growth Serum Roll On How is this Folli+ Advanced hair growth serum roll-on different from regular roll-on? This is an advanced hair growth serum roll-on formulated with highest clinically studied hair growth actives and an enhanced delivery system to support deeper scalp absorption. It addresses several root causes of hair fall and thinning to help strengthen follicles and support visible hair regrowth with consistent use. How is this different from a regular hair serum? Unlike regular serums that primarily sit on the scalp surface, this serum uses advanced penetration technology inspired by microneedle delivery systems. It creates temporary pathways on the scalp to help key actives reach closer to the hair roots - where they can work more effectively. How do I use it? Apply the roll-on directly to the affected areas of the scalp once or twice daily. Gently massage for better spread and absorption. For best results, use consistently for at least 3 months. Do not wash off immediately after application. When can I expect to see results? Visible improvements typically appear with consistent daily use over time. Most users report noticeable reduction in hair fall and improved hair strength around 8–12 weeks, with continued improvement up to and beyond 3 months. Individual results may vary based on hair condition and routine consistency. Is it safe to use daily? Yes - the serum is designed for everyday use and is lightweight, non-greasy, and fast-absorbing. It does not involve invasive procedures and is safe for regular application as directed. Can I use this with other hair products? Yes - you can continue using your regular shampoo, conditioner, or other hair care products. Apply this serum first to the scalp, followed by your other products as usual. Avoid applying heavy oils or styling products immediately after use for best absorption. Will this cause irritation or redness? The formula is designed to be gentle and scalp-friendly. Some users may experience slight, temporary tingling upon application, which is normal. If you experience persistent irritation or discomfort, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist. What should I avoid during use? Avoid washing your hair immediately after application. Also avoid using strong chemical treatments or irritants without professional guidance. Always do a patch test if you have sensitive skin. How should I store this product? Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep the cap closed when not in use.
